title: Meet Bari Weiss’s Israel Flag-Waving News Correspondent
author: Justin Baragona
content:
Good evening, and welcome to this week's **' Ragebait'**!

**Justin Baragona** here, bringing you the latest dispatches from Bari World
and the right-wing industrial outrage complex. In tonight's edition, we
profile the newest CBS News correspondent and what he has in common with
**Bari Weiss** , **Sean Hannity '**s engagement with a bit of stolen valor,
**Fox** doing its level best to spin Trump's long and boring State of the
Union, and what **CBS staffers** think about the **Peter Attia** saga.
